run_filter_tsv_keep_matching: run filter_tsv.py with --tsv to keep stdin lines matching TSV filenames
run_filter_tsv_exclude_matching: run filter_tsv.py with --tsv --keep to exclude stdin lines matching TSV filenames
run_filter_tsv_no_skip: run filter_tsv.py with --tsv --no-skip to process TSV without skipping header row
review_get_fname: review the get_fname function that extracts base filenames from tab-separated lines
refactor_filter_tsv_keep_logic: refactor filter_tsv.py to support additional filtering modes beyond the keep flag
